title: American Red Cross
description: The American Red Cross brand palette centers on red (#ed1b2e) with white (#ffffff), black (#000000), and neutrals (#6d6e70, #d7d7d8, #9f9fa3, #e2d7ac, #b4a996), plus gold (#ecb731), greens (#8ec06c, #537b35), blues (#c4dff6, #56a0d3, #0091cd, #004b79), and deep red (#7f181b). These colors appear in the organization's official brand materials.
